registryEntry.label: Disable Inactive Accounts Inactive 90+ Days
registryEntry.get_command: $cut = (Get-Date).AddDays(-90); $enabled = @(Get-MgUser -Filter 'accountEnabled eq true' -All -Property Id,DisplayName,UserPrincipalName,SignInActivity -ErrorAction Stop); $stale = @($enabled | Where-Object { $_.SignInActivity.LastSignInDateTime -ne $null -and $_.SignInActivity.LastSignInDateTime -lt $cut -and $_.UserPrincipalName -ne '{operatorUPN}' -and $_.UserPrincipalName -ne '{breakGlassUPN}' }); $missing = @(@('{operatorUPN}','{breakGlassUPN}') | Where-Object { @($enabled | ForEach-Object { $_.UserPrincipalName }) -notcontains $_ }); [pscustomobject]@{ enabledCount = $enabled.Count; staleNonExcludedEnabledCount = $stale.Count; exclusionsEnabled = ($missing.Count -eq 0) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
registryEntry.set_command: $cut = (Get-Date).AddDays(-90); Get-MgUser -Filter 'accountEnabled eq true' -All -Property Id,DisplayName,UserPrincipalName,SignInActivity -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.SignInActivity.LastSignInDateTime -ne $null -and $_.SignInActivity.LastSignInDateTime -lt $cut -and $_.UserPrincipalName -ne '{operatorUPN}' -and $_.UserPrincipalName -ne '{breakGlassUPN}' } | ForEach-Object { Update-MgUser -UserId $_.Id -AccountEnabled:$false }
evidence_commands: Get-MgUser -Filter 'accountEnabled eq true' -All -Property DisplayName,UserPrincipalName,SignInActivity -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object DisplayName,UserPrincipalName,SignInActivity | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10

metadata.commandExecuted: $cut = (Get-Date).AddDays(-90); Get-MgUser -Filter 'accountEnabled eq true' -All -Property Id,DisplayName,UserPrincipalName,SignInActivity -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.SignInActivity.LastSignInDateTime -ne $null -and $_.SignInActivity.LastSignInDateTime -lt $cut -and $_.UserPrincipalName -ne '{operatorUPN}' -and $_.UserPrincipalName -ne '{breakGlassUPN}' } | ForEach-Object { Update-MgUser -UserId $_.Id -AccountEnabled:$false }
